subject: Weekend close: one-time credits to secure Q2 commitment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Dawson <emma@quantumledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekend close: one-time credits to secure Q2 commitment

Emma —

Quick note as we head into the weekend. Quantum Ledger has been a strong fit in our pilot, and given your timeline to finalize tooling for production, we can make a one-time hosted-credit offer to remove friction and get you across the finish line this quarter. Proposed structure:

- $5,000 in hosted inference credits (redeemable against Redwood API usage)
- Valid for 90 days from activation
- Applies to first invoice post-activation; not combinable with other promotional stacking

This is a limited, one-off close incentive tied to an LOI/DocuSign signature by EOD Monday (6/16). If that works, I’ll attach an official offer doc and route for signature — Ben and Marissa are looped for approval.

If you need any compliance notes (SOC2, logging, retention) I can attach our security summary.

Curious if this removes the last blocker on your side?

Thanks —

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
(415) 555-0198
From: Emma Dawson <emma@quantumledger.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@quantumledger.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekend close: one-time credits to secure Q2 commitment

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the quick follow. A few clarifying questions before we move to signatures:

1) Is this strictly hosted API usage only? We need to confirm we won’t be billed for any dedicated/private components.
2) Will there be a standalone agreement or an amendment to the standard SOW? Procurement prefers a PDF we can attach to the PO.
3) A short note on data retention and deletion policy would help (our security team flagged that as high priority).

If you can send a one-page offer and the security summary, procurement will review over the weekend. We’re aiming for a final decision Monday.

Best,
Emma Dawson
Head of ML Platform
Quantum Ledger
emma@quantumledger.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Jordan —

I’ve reviewed the ask. Approve a one-time $5,000 hosted-credit grant for Quantum Ledger under the following guardrails: 

- Credits are for Redwood hosted API only (not redeemable for Dedicated or Private deployments).
- Validity 90 days from activation; non-transferable and no cash value.
- Offer requires signed acceptance (DocuSign) and countersigned PO if procurement requests it.
- No technical support SLA changes — standard onboarding support applies.

Attached is a short offer PDF to send to the customer. Please do not change the wording without rep'ing me.
